technique_name: Explain in detail the process of mitosis.
description: Mitosis is the process of cell division that occurs in eukaryotic organisms. The process produces two daughter cells that are genetically identical to the parent cell. It begins with the duplication of the chromosome, which occurs during interphase. During the prophase stage of mitosis, the chromosomes and the mitotic spindle condense and the nuclear membrane disintegrates. During metaphase, the chromosomes align on the metaphase plate.
